nodes.text: Djokovic achieved a record of 106 wins in the Wimbledon tennis tournament, surpassing Roger Federer's record for most wins.

The most Men's Singles Wins at Wimbledon: NOVAK DJOKOVIC: 106 Roger Federer: 105 Novak making more history ... Federer has 105 wins with 8 ... No man has won more matches at Wimbledon, ever. Novak Djokovic overtakes Roger Federer's record to secure a historic 106th gentlemen's singles ... Historic milestone: Djokovic beat Safiullin 7-6, 6-3, 3-6, 6-3 to surpass Federer's 105 Wimbledon wins, setting a new men's singles record ...
